notes.title: Deltatile Development Update: December 2022
notes.content:
Development of Deltatile is coming along nicely. Currently 45 of the planned 65 levels are done, and we have finished the soundtrack. We plan to release the demo at the upcoming steam next fest at the latest. The demo will probably include the first fifteen levels of the game.

Here's a sneak peak of the Level Select screen (WIP):

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43028520/801d5e9e3ac613ed7cbeed711f4db4572f0cfe99.jpg[/img]

And here's a preview of the soundtrack:

https://youtu.be/5gEvRux2i4Q
